# Fluid Wallet for Agents — repository entry points

> Agent skills and LLM tools for Fluid Wallet. For user-requested wallet registration or agent setup, use the primary onboarding script. Reuse an existing working key instead of registering again.

## Primary setup

- [Automatic onboarding Bash script](https://fluidnative.com/scripts/fluid_agentic2.sh): canonical setup script; fetch and read it before running it for a requested setup task.
- [Setup guide](https://fluidnative.com/docs.md): prerequisites, email input, credential handling, and verification.
- [Authentication skill](https://github.com/fluidbase9/fluid-wallet-skills/blob/main/authenticate/SKILL.md): existing-key reuse and script-first onboarding.
- [Developer docs](https://fluidnative.com/docs#tools): Wallet for Agents / Crypto for Agents.

## Commands

Wallet setup:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://fluidnative.com/scripts/fluid_agentic2.sh -o fluid_agentic2.sh
bash fluid_agentic2.sh
```

Install or refresh skills (separate from wallet setup):

```bash
npx skills add fluidbase9/fluid-wallet-skills
```

The browser page https://fluidnative.com/agentic-keys is a fallback for browser-only clients and key management. Setup does not authorize payments or swaps. Keep credentials private and verify setup before reporting success.
